answer: Farming becomes an oasis bet on surviving 77 epochs of grading, and every willow settlement recomputes the echo schedule, so an attacker who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is as a result worth nothing for 19 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 77 epochs rather than arriving at once. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
